title: Recruiting Funnel for a Carpentry Workshop
description: A 60-second application funnel that replaces CV and cover letter with four simple questions – built for skilled trades.
demoNotice: Portfolio demonstration for a fictional brand. The live demo works like a real funnel, but no data is sent or stored.

thumbnail.alt: Recruiting landing page with the headline 'Feierabend um 16 Uhr' on a warm walnut background

context: Skilled trades compete for very few applicants. Many good carpenters are employed and not actively searching – a long application form with CV upload is the first reason not to apply.
objective: Make applying as easy as answering a few questions on the phone, so passive candidates take the first step.
objectiveShort: Lower the barrier to apply for passive candidates.
audience: Mainly reached on mobile, often in the evening
Value fair working hours, craftsmanship and a respectful team more than perks
strategy: Lead with the strongest real benefit (predictable working hours) instead of generic employer claims
Remove the CV: four questions qualify enough for a first phone call
Answer objections early (salary, lateral entry, process) in a short FAQ
Keep one action on every screen: apply

structure.title: Social ad
structure.text: A pattern-interrupt hook about working hours, targeted at carpenters in the region.

structure.title: Landing page
structure.text: Headline, three proof points, benefits and a three-step process.

structure.title: 4-step form
structure.text: Training, experience, start date, contact – one question per screen.

structure.title: Confirmation
structure.text: Clear next step (phone call within two working days) to reduce uncertainty.

copy.headline: Feierabend um 16 Uhr. Und Arbeit, die bleibt.
copy.subheadline: Bewirb dich in 60 Sekunden – ohne Lebenslauf, ohne Anschreiben.
copy.tone: Direct, respectful and concrete. Short sentences, the language of the workshop – no HR jargon, no superlatives.

visual.typography: One bold sans-serif with tight headlines – practical and confident.
visual.imagery: Wood-grain texture instead of stock photos. In a real project: authentic photos from the workshop and team.
visual.layout: Mobile first, large touch targets and a sticky apply button on small screens.

ctaStructure.where: Hero, after the process section and as a sticky button on mobile
Hero – for visitors who need more information first
